captures.name: setup
captures.bodyText:
Setup

Everything for pictures, 3D models, faces and animation from text is installed (16 GB on disk). Blender is not connected.

Setting up for the first time, or on another computer? The guided setup checks your computer, asks where the models go and what you want to make, logs you in to Hugging Face and installs it all in one go.
Open the guided setup
What this app can do

Each feature needs some files on this computer. Install the ones you want to use.

Concept images
Makes four pictures from your description.
Installed · 2 GB
Check and repair
3D model, Faithful (recommended)
Makes the 3D model from your picture. This is the recommended one.
Installed · 2 GB
Check and repair
3D model, Fast (alternative)
Makes the 3D model from your picture with less memory. Use it if Faithful does not run.
Installed · 2 GB
Check and repair
Face detail
Sharpens your picture before it is copied onto the face.
Installed · 2 GB
Check and repair
Texture detail
Redraws a texture's fine detail, such as buttons, stitching and wood grain (Z-Image + Tile, 2 GB more).
Installed · 2 GB
Check and repair
Parts
Finds the pieces of a model from a click and names them; the game files keep each piece as its own object (GeoSAM2, 0.6 GB).
Installed · 2 GB
Check and repair
Text to motion
Makes an animation from a sentence (NVIDIA Kimodo). Needs a Hugging Face login with access to Meta Llama 3.
Installed · 2 GB
